purpose: Present the consequence of a preceding action or assumption.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
Press this button. Then the screen will change.
The shop is closed tomorrow. Then we need to buy it today.
I opened the window. Then a cold breeze came in.
restrictions: Can describe a sequence or an inference from what was just said.
mistake: Unlike そう言えば, it develops a consequence rather than recalling a topic.

segments.role: Present the consequence of a preceding action or assumption. Sentence + そうすると + consequence
